trend.summary: A genre this month, ahead of Black Friday (27 Nov 2026): people making Black Friday sale banners, posters and Stories with AI image tools. The guides centre on getting the text right: Miraflow (17 Oct) warns that repeating a discount can turn '40% OFF' into '4O% OOF' and to ask for the number once; Segmind (11 Nov) generated a 20-render sale kit and found a closing 'exactly these text elements' clause kept the text exact, recommends checking the coupon line by eye, and saw a longer translated line run into the product.
trend.demo: funkbox makes one of these in the video: a 1080x1920 Story-size Black Friday poster for the fictional GLOWMOP brand (BLACK FRIDAY, 40% OFF, $149 struck through, $89, CODE: BF40), every string from a copy deck and checked by the poster's text audit, exported as PNG, SVG and PDF (assets/poster/), and the same 12x zoom of the '$89' from the PNG and from the PDF (work/zoom.py).
